welcome.title: Welcome to BlockingBear
welcome.body: Follow this short tutorial to learn how the application works.

nav.title: Chats and Projects
nav.body: New Chat for a single conversation. Projects to work on a set of documents: upload them once, anonymize them and chat about them.

mode.title: Anonymized or plain chat
mode.body: In an anonymized chat personal data is replaced before it leaves the server, and answers come back with the real names. A plain chat sends the text as is. You choose once, at the start.
mode.bodyRequired: In an anonymized chat personal data is replaced before it leaves the server, and answers come back with the real names. On this server the administrator made it mandatory: plain chat is not available.

menu.title: Your profile
menu.body: From here you open Settings (password, terms to always anonymize, preferred model) and Logout. The flag next to it switches the interface language.

model.title: The model
model.body: Pick which model handles the conversation. Changing it from this dropdown affects this chat only; to use a different default, choose one from the Settings page.

options.title: Model options
options.body: Here are the conversation options, such as web search and some technical model settings. If you're not sure what they are, the defaults are fine.

anonTags.title: Categories to anonymize
anonTags.body: Here you decide which kinds of personal data (names, addresses, phone numbers, …) are anonymized in this chat before leaving the server.

review.title: Check before sending
review.body: With this box ticked, before every send you see the original and the anonymized version of the message and attachments, and you can adjust the anonymization. Without it, the message goes out right away.

composer.title: Write and attach
composer.body: Type your message and send with Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). Click the paperclip icon to attach documents: in an "anonymized" chat they are anonymized before being sent.

drop.title: Upload the documents
drop.bodyAnon: Drag the project documents here, or click to pick them. Each file is anonymized and then waits: you must confirm it before it enters the chats, after checking the result.
drop.bodyPlain: Drag the project documents here, or click to pick them. Once uploaded they are available in the project chats.

newChat.title: Chat about the documents
newChat.body: From here you open a project chat: the model reads the confirmed documents and answers based on them.

new.title: Your first project
new.body: A project gathers several documents under one anonymization map: the same names become the same placeholders across all its files and chats. Start here.
